_about: Corporate PACs of major U.S. defense/weapons contractors used for the 'weapons-industry PAC money' flag. Selection: the five largest DoD contractors by FY2024 contract obligations (CRS In Focus IF10600, from the SAM.gov FY2024 Top 100 Contractors report) plus other DoD prime contractors whose main business is weapons systems, military aircraft, warships, munitions or defense electronics. Every committee ID was checked on api.open.fec.gov (committee type Q, connected organization as listed) on 2026-10-23. Defense contractors only: gun-lobby groups (NRA etc.) are not included. Edit this file to change the list; the site reads it at build time.

sources.name: CRS In Focus IF10600, Defense Primer: Department of Defense Contractors (FY2024 top five by obligations)
